description: This file defines the API functions for the CCSP management server component, including functions for setting and getting parameters, managing table rows, and handling parameter attributes.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_SetParameterValues
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values on the management server, with an option to commit the changes.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits or rolls back pending parameter changes.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_GetParameterValues
methods.description: Retrieves the values of specified parameters.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_AddTblRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to a table identified by objectName.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_DeleteTblRow
methods.description: Deletes a row from a table identified by objectName.

methods.name: CcspManagementServer_GetParameterNames
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names at a specified level.
